title: 180-day repeat-purchase rate, 2024 first-order cohort
prompt: Of customers whose very first completed order happened in 2024, what fraction placed a second completed order within 180 days of that first one?
population: Customers whose earliest completed order falls in 2024.
metricDefinition: customers (first completed order in 2024) with a second completed order within 180 days after the first, divided by all customers whose first completed order was in 2024.
transformationPlan: find each customer's first completed order date
keep customers whose first order fell in 2024
check for a second completed order within 180 days after the first
referenceSql: WITH first_order AS (SELECT customer_id, min(order_date) AS first_date FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id), cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, first_date FROM first_order WHERE first_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND first_date < DATE '2025-01-01') SELECT count(DISTINCT c.customer_id) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date > c.first_date AND o.order_date <= c.first_date + INTERVAL '180 days'))::DOUBLE / count(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS repeat_rate FROM cohort c
